title: Reinforcing Recursive Language Models
authors: NovaSky-AI / SkyRL contributors (specific blog authors not surfaced on the page)
headline: RL fine-tune small (4B) models to behave as native recursive language models (RLMs) by training parent and child RLMs under a single, shared policy. Children inherit the parent's GRPO advantage so the whole recursive trajectory is optimized as one trajectory.
key_result: On an evidence-selection task over multi-paper scientific corpora, an RL-fine-tuned Qwen3.5-4B matches Claude Sonnet 4.6 (avg rubric 0.6) using the same RLM scaffold + Python REPL — at a fraction of the size and cost.
